notes: No eligible stars. BD+43° 3654 (T:p1-b9, T:p1-b10, T:p3-b2) is described as a runaway/blue straggler ejected from Cyg OB2; the escape/recoil discussion concerns the parent cluster, not present-day escape from the Milky Way. PSR B2020+28 and PSR B2021+51 (T:p3-b8, T:p4-b1) are high-velocity pulsars with a proposed Cyg OB2 origin, but no explicit Galactic-boundness assessment is made. A37 (T:p2-b2) is a high-velocity cluster runaway, while ζ Pup and λ Cep (T:p1-b9) are comparison runaways; none is explicitly retained as a Galactic unbound candidate.
